senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; prob. √אה = או, cmp. אַוְנָא)tent, shelter.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 21b:7">Succ. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ עראי</he> a temporary dwelling. <he>א׳ קבע</he> a permanent dwelling.—
<cite ref="Nazir 55a:2">Naz. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ זרוק</he> a movable cover, e.g. a person carried in a vehicle over a grave, v. foreg.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 27b:22">B. Bath. 27ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>א׳ הטומאה</he> something spread over an unclean object, e.g. a tree shading a corpse; v. <cite ref="A00500">foreg.</cite>

<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 7:2">Naz. VII, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00493"><he>אָהִיל</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>אוֹהֳלִים</he>, (<cite ref="A00488"><he>אָהֳולִין</he></cite>) <he>אוֹהֳלִין</he>. Y. Sabb. XX, beg. 17ᶜ <he>נטע א׳</he> to spread sheets over poles &c. (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:12">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:14">XIII</cite>), 14, a. e. <he>עשה א׳</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:10:6">Y. Erub. I, 19ᵈ</cite> <he>א׳ בשיירה</he> tents in a caravan, <he>א׳ שבמחנה</he> in a camp.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:25">Tosef. Kil. V, 25</cite> <cite ref="A00488"><he>אהולין</he></cite> ed. Zuck.
